speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it? Have you noticed any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea accompanying the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze that radiates down to my left arm. It started suddenly an hour ago and hasn't gotten any better with rest; I'm also feeling quite short of breath and a bit nauseous. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a known history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, but the sudden onset of central chest pain radiating to the left arm, accompanied by shortness of breath and nausea, is highly concerning for an acute cardiac event. Given your symptoms, I need to evaluate your current cardiac status immediately. REQUEST TEST: ECG REQUEST TEST: Troponin_Level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Electrocardiogram: ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF, consistent with inferior myocardial infarction. Troponin I Levels: Elevated at 0.4 ng/mL (normal <0.01 ng/mL).

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Inferior Myocardial Infarction (complicating Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy).
